title: too
summary: Слово **too** («слишком»): **too hot**, **too much**, **too many**, **too ... to** — когда чего-то больше, чем нужно.
ru:
## too = «слишком»
**Too** значит «больше, чем нужно» — и это обычно плохо.
> It's **too hot** to work. — Слишком жарко, чтобы работать.
> This bag is **too heavy**. — Эта сумка слишком тяжёлая.

## too + прилагательное / наречие
> Don't buy that dress. It's **too expensive**. — Не покупай это платье. Оно слишком дорогое.
> You're driving **too fast**. — Ты едешь слишком быстро.
> Запомните: **too** не значит «очень». Очень = **very**.
> It's **very** nice. (хорошо) — It's **too** hot. (плохо)

## too much / too many
- **too much** + неисчисляемое: **too much** sugar, **too much** noise, **too much** work
- **too many** + исчисляемое во множественном числе: **too many** people, **too many** cars
> There's **too much** traffic. — Слишком много машин на дороге.
> I've got **too many** things to do. — У меня слишком много дел.

## too ... to ...
После **too + прилагательное** часто идёт **to + глагол** — «слишком …, чтобы …».
> It's **too late to** call him. — Слишком поздно, чтобы ему звонить.
> She's **too tired to** walk. — Она слишком устала, чтобы идти.
Если речь о конкретном человеке: **too ... for somebody to ...**
> The bag is **too heavy for me to** carry. — Сумка слишком тяжёлая, чтобы я её понесла.
Можно и коротко: **too ... for me**.
> This coat is **too big for me**. — Это пальто мне слишком велико.

## too и not enough
Одну и ту же мысль можно сказать двумя способами.
> It's **too cold** to swim. = It **isn't warm enough** to swim.
> The room is **too small**. = It **isn't big enough**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~too much people~~ → **too many** people
- ~~too many money~~ → **too much** money
- ~~too much hot~~ → **too hot**
- ~~too tired for walk~~ → too tired **to walk**
- ~~I'm too happy to see you~~ → I'm **very** happy to see you (если это хорошо, а не проблема)
en:
## What does too mean?
**Too** means «more than we want or need». It is usually a problem.
> It's **too hot** to work.
> This bag is **too heavy**.

## too + adjective / adverb
> Don't buy that dress. It's **too expensive**.
> You're driving **too fast**.
**Too** is not the same as **very**. It's **very** nice (good). It's **too** hot (bad).

## too much / too many
- **too much** + uncountable noun: **too much** sugar, **too much** noise
- **too many** + plural noun: **too many** people, **too many** cars
> There's **too much** traffic.
> I've got **too many** things to do.

## too ... to ...
After **too + adjective** we often use **to + verb**.
> It's **too late to** call him.
> She's **too tired to** walk.
To say who: **too ... for somebody to ...**
> The bag is **too heavy for me to** carry.
We can also say: **too ... for me**.
> This coat is **too big for me**.

## too and not enough
> It's **too cold** to swim. = It **isn't warm enough** to swim.
> The room is **too small**. = It **isn't big enough**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~too much people~~ → **too many** people
- ~~too many money~~ → **too much** money
- ~~too tired for walk~~ → too tired **to walk**
structure:
## Формулы
| Конструкция | Пример |
|---|---|
| **too** + adjective | It's **too noisy**. |
| **too** + adverb | He speaks **too fast**. |
| **too much** + uncountable | **too much** coffee |
| **too many** + plural | **too many** mistakes |
| **too** + adjective + **to** + verb | **too tired to** think |
| **too** + adjective + **for** + person | **too big for** me |
| **too** + adjective + for + person + **to** + verb | **too difficult for** me **to** understand |

## too vs enough
| too | not enough |
|---|---|
| The tea is **too hot**. | The tea **isn't cool enough**. |
| It's **too small**. | It **isn't big enough**. |
| It's **too far** to walk. | It **isn't near enough** to walk. |

## Важно
- **too** ставим **перед** прилагательным: too cold
- **enough** ставим **после** прилагательного: cold enough
- **too** нельзя ставить в конец позитивного ответа вместо **very**

exercises.instruction: Вставьте **too** и прилагательное из списка: cold, expensive, heavy, tired, late, small.
exercises.example: I can't carry this bag. It's **too heavy**.
